definitions.explanation: To rub or scratch a surface with fingernails or claws, often to relieve an itch or to scrape something away.

examples.japanese: かさぶたを{掻|か}いてはいけない。
{蚊|か}に{刺|さ}されたところが{痒|かゆ}くて{掻|か}いてしまった。
examples.english: The mosquito bite was so itchy that I ended up scratching it.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
・Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
・Pattern: Xを{掻|か}く

IDIOMS:
・{頭|あたま}を{掻|か}く (to scratch one's head - showing embarrassment or confusion)
・{汗|あせ}を{掻|か}く (to sweat)
・{恥|はじ}を{掻|か}く (to be embarrassed)

Note: Not to be confused with {書|か}く (to write) or {描|か}く (to draw).
